claims.claim: Haven’t been used in about 3 years.
claims.evidence: The report only shows the bicycle’s appearance (fork, tyres, racks, disc rotors) and does not show usage history.

claims.claim: Just change the tires and oil the chain then you’re good to go.
claims.evidence: The report does not show tyre condition (tread depth/sidewall cracks), chain condition, or whether brakes/gears/suspension work.

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn, cracked, or have dry rot; also possible punctures/slow leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up of both tyres (tread depth + sidewall cracks) plus a clip showing the tyres inflated and holding pressure (or a quick ride test).
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing tyre replacement and/or tubes (worst case: tyres not roadworthy).

risks.risk: Brakes may be weak or uneven (disc rotors may be warped; pads may be thin; calipers may stick).
risks.proof: A short video of a brake test: squeeze front and rear brakes hard while stationary and show the wheel stopping promptly, plus close-ups of brake pads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may require service/parts (worst case: pads/adjustment needed).

risks.risk: Gears may not shift correctly (cables stretched, derailleur misaligned, chain worn).
risks.proof: A clip shifting through all gears smoothly (front and rear) while pedaling, plus a close-up of the drivetrain/chain wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears may need adjustment or chain/cassette service (worst case: drivetrain wear).

risks.risk: Suspension fork may be seized or leaking (front suspension condition not verifiable from one angle).
risks.proof: A video compressing the front fork repeatedly and showing rebound; plus a close-up for oil leaks/dust seals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as suspension may need servicing (worst case: fork service or replacement).

risks.risk: Frame/wheels may have hidden damage (bent rims, cracks, dents) not visible from the single photo angle.
risks.proof: Photos of both wheels from the side (showing rim wobble) and close-ups of frame joints for cracks/dents; ideally a wheel spin test clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible minor damage requiring inspection/repair (worst case: wheel truing or parts).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete set (lock, pump, bell, lights, spare tubes/reflectors).
risks.proof: A full layout photo of included accessories and a check of all mounts (front/rear lights, reflectors, lock).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal included items (worst case: no extras).

proof_requests: Send a short video of a full brake test (front + rear) showing strong stopping while stationary.
Send a clip shifting through all gears smoothly while pedaling.
Send close-ups of tyre tread + sidewalls (cracks/dry rot) and brake pad thickness.
Send a video compressing the front suspension fork and showing rebound; include a close-up of dust seals for leaks.
Send photos of both wheels spinning (rim wobble) and close-ups of the frame joints for cracks/dents.
Confirm wheel size/frame size and provide any readable brand/model/serial number (clear close-up).
List and show all included accessories (lock, pump, lights, bell, spare tubes/tyres).
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies it as a black/blue bicycle with front suspension, knobby tyres, front and rear disc brakes, and a rear cargo rack, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition. Seller usage/repair claims are not verifiable from the report, so the price should assume it may need tyres and basic service.
